title: Contribution simulator
subtitle: See what an amount saved every month could turn into, with the rate you enter.
notice: This is only a simulation, made with the values you entered. {{appName}} does not promise or suggest any return, and this is not investment advice. The values are gross: they do not deduct taxes, fees or inflation. Real returns vary.

form.title: Simulation values
form.rateHint: You choose the rate. Per year, it is converted to the equivalent monthly rate.

errors.invalidRate: Invalid rate. Use numbers, with up to 4 decimal places (for example, 0.8).
errors.rateTooHighMonth: The rate goes up to {{max}}% per month.
errors.rateTooHighYear: The rate goes up to {{max}}% per year.
errors.invalidTerm: Enter the term as a whole number, from 1.
errors.termTooLong: The term goes up to 50 years (600 months).

incomplete: Fill in the rate, the term and the starting amount or the monthly contribution to see the simulation.
fixErrors: Fix the marked fields to see the simulation.
tooLarge: The result goes beyond {{max}}, the largest amount {{appName}} shows. Lower the amounts, the rate or the term.

chart.title: Simulated growth
chart.caption: After {{period}}, with {{contributed}} contributed, the simulation reaches {{total}}, with {{growth}} of simulated return.
chart.tableLabel: See the simulation as a table
